73196.t: BRIANCHON'S POINT OF THE TANGENTIAL HEXAGON OF ROUSSEL'S HEXAGON
no: This preamble is based of a definition of "excevian triangle" by Clark Kimberling, October 15, 2026, and subsequent findings by Peter Moses, October 16-17, 2026.

Let P = \(p : q : r\) be a triangle center. Let A'(P) = reflection of P about the external bisector of A, and define B'(P) and C'(P) cyclically, and let A'(P) = -(b*c*p) - (b + c)*(c*q + b*r) : b^2*r : c^2*q}, with barycentrics for B'(P) and C'(P) defined cyclically.

We abbreviate the triangle A'(P)B'(P)C'(P) as T(P). This triangle is here named the **excevian triangle** of P. Some properties of T(P) follow: (1) T(P) is perspective to ABC; the perspector is the isogonal conjgate of P. (2) T(X_40) = excentral triangle, T(X_1) = Aquilla triangle. (3) T(P) is perspective to the medial triangle for points P on the conic that passes through X(i) for these i: 1, 6, 10, 46, 1213, 2270, 10974, 22277, 31321. (4) T(P) is perspective to the anticomplementary triangle for points P on the conic that passes through X(i) for these i: 1, 6, 8, 1046, 1654, 3779, 37567, 41329, 41834, 70227. (5) T(P) is perspective to the excentral triangle for points P on the cubic that passes through X(i) for these i: 1, 40, 164, 399, 517, 1276, 1277, 5541, 11752, 11789, 66059, 70227, 71678, 71679, 73197, 73198, 73199, 732200, 732201 and 73197-731202. This cubic, IK1459, is the Neuberg cubic (K001) of the excentral triangle. It is also the excentral polar inverse of K206. (6) T(P) is perspective to the tangential triangle for points P on the cubic that passes through X(i) for these i: 2, 30, 191, 6154. (7) T(P) is perspective to the orthic triangle for points P on the cubic that passes through X(i) for these i: 3, 30, 442, 8072, 8073, 12691. (8) T(P) is perspective to the intouch triangle for points P on the line X_1X_3 or the incircle.
Triangles named above are listed in César Lozada's **Index of Triangles**, accessible from **Tables** at the top of this page.
